Package neqsim.process.equipment.energy

Class ElectricMotor

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.energy.EnergyConverter
neqsim.process.equipment.energy.ElectricMotor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, ProcessEquipmentInterface, ProcessElementInterface, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface
public class ElectricMotor extends EnergyConverter
Electric motor converting electrical power to shaft work.

The default model uses constant efficiency. An optional ElectricMotorDriver adds rated power, fixed-speed or VFD capability, part-load efficiency, and ambient/altitude derating using the same driver model already used by NeqSim compressor studies.

    • getCombinedEnvironmentalDeratingFactor

      private double getCombinedEnvironmentalDeratingFactor()
      Gets combined ambient-temperature and altitude derating.

      The legacy driver returns early below 40 degrees Celsius, which omits altitude derating. The energy-network motor preserves that driver behavior for temperature while applying the missing altitude factor whenever the early return is active.
